description: Search GetMyHotels for hotels matching a query. Returns a list of results with ids that can be passed to `fetch` for full details. Provide the destination and travel dates in the query.

checkOut.description: Check-out date, ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be after check-in.

childrenAges.description: Age of each child at check-in. Length should equal `children`.

destination.description: City, region, or place to search (e.g. 'Paris', 'Goa', 'Lower Manhattan').

guestNationality.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 guest nationality (e.g. 'US', 'GB'). Affects supplier pricing.

keywords.description: Optional free-text preferences, e.g. 'beachfront pool spa'.

query.description: Natural-language search, e.g. 'hotels in Lisbon 2026-08-10 to 2026-08-14 for 2 adults'.

name: search
title: Search
